title: Korean BBQ Restaurant-Style Macaroni Salad
shortDescription: Elbow macaroni, cucumber, carrot, and corn are cooled promptly and folded with commercial mayonnaise for a sweet-tangy Korean BBQ restaurant-style side.
culturalContext: Creamy macaroni salad is a familiar side at some Korean barbecue restaurants and reflects modern cross-cultural restaurant cooking. Formulas vary and this is explicitly restaurant-style.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}

ingredients.preparation: drained; can intact and label checked

instructions.heading: Prepare clean vegetables
instructions.action: Wash cucumber and carrot under running water, dry, and dice on a clean board.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Vegetables are clean, dry, and evenly diced.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep ready-to-eat tools away from raw meat and seafood.

instructions.heading: Cook macaroni
instructions.action: Boil macaroni in salted water until tender according to package directions.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Macaroni is tender without a hard core.

instructions.heading: Drain and cool shallow
instructions.action: Drain thoroughly, spread macaroni on a clean sheet pan, and cool promptly before refrigerating.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Macaroni is no longer hot and is chilled promptly.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not leave cooked pasta at room temperature beyond safe limits.

instructions.heading: Mix dressing
instructions.action: Whisk commercial mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a clean cold bowl.
instructions.safetyNote: Verify mayonnaise and vinegar labels and keep mayonnaise refrigerated.

instructions.heading: Combine cold
instructions.action: Fold chilled macaroni, cucumber, carrot, corn, and dressing together with clean utensils.
instructions.safetyNote: All components must be cool before mixing.

instructions.heading: Chill and serve
instructions.action: Cover, refrigerate at least 30 minutes, and portion with a clean utensil.
instructions.safetyNote: Discard portions held above refrigeration limits or contaminated by shared utensils.

grillSetup: Not applicable; this banchan is prepared without a grill.
targetInternalTemperature: Cook macaroni until tender according to package directions; cool promptly and keep the finished salad at or below 40°F / 4°C.
foodSafetyNotes: Cook pasta according to package directions and cool promptly in a shallow layer.
Keep finished salad at or below 40°F / 4°C.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains wheat/gluten and egg; verify macaroni and mayonnaise labels for additional allergens.

substitutions: Use a verified gluten-free pasta only after retesting texture and cooling.
ingredientSourcing: Choose intact pasta and corn packages and commercial pasteurized mayonnaise.
makeAhead: Prepare up to 1 day ahead and keep covered and refrigerated.
storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 3 days pending review.
leftovers: Retain only clean continuously refrigerated salad.
servingSuggestions: Serve cold in small portions with Korean barbecue.

faq.question: Is this a traditional Korean dish?
faq.answer: No. It is explicitly a Korean BBQ restaurant-style adaptation.

faq.question: Why cool pasta before dressing?
faq.answer: It prevents prolonged warm holding and protects the mayonnaise dressing.
